title: Compatibility after fixing selected literals
statement: Let $T$ be a conjunction of literals on $n$ Boolean coordinates, let $\rho$ be a coordinate restriction compatible with $T$, and let $S$ be a set of literal positions whose coordinates are free under $\rho$. For $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, suppose that the relative bit of $x$ is $0$ at every free literal position. Fix the coordinates of the literals in $S$ to the signs encoded by $x$. The resulting coordinate restriction remains compatible with $T$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite set $S$ contained in the free literal positions
The relative bit is $0$ at every free literal position
